entries.name: late-address-response
entries.claim: A late provider reply cannot attach coordinates after the source changes.

kills.name: Address publication preserves the old envelope, stops the prior reader, and serves governed user text without a provider
kills.expected: the late geocode was accepted after the source address changed

entries.name: shared-record-company-pin
entries.claim: A shared record returns only the selected company installation’s provider pin.
entries.original: FROM platform.address_geocodes WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND environment_id=$2 AND company_id=$3 AND installation_id=$4 AND record_id=$5 AND field_id=$6 AND address_revision=$7 AND release_id=$8 AND fence=$9
entries.replacement: FROM platform.address_geocodes WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND environment_id=$2 AND $3::uuid IS NOT NULL AND $4::uuid IS NOT NULL AND record_id=$5 AND field_id=$6 AND address_revision=$7 AND release_id=$8 AND fence=$9

kills.name: Address publication preserves the old envelope, stops the prior reader, and serves governed user text without a provider
kills.expected: the other company received a provider pin for this shared record
